email_subject: Possible adverse event report - DemoCardolol patient with a mild skin rash
email_body:
[SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL DATA — educational prototype only, no real patient or reporter information]

Hello Safety Team,


I am a treating physician at Demo Family Practice (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

A 30-year-old male patient with a history of hypertension received their fourth dose of DemoCardolol (dose: 25mg) via subcutaneous injection.
Treatment started on 2026-02-15.
Approximately 6 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed a mild skin rash.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
J. Haddad (fictional reporter)
Demo Family Practice
Contact: demo.reporter718@fictionalclinic-demo.example (synthetic contact info)
